sections.decision: Keep the printed correction date and Supersedure: None; no lifecycle stamp appears on the rendered PDF, so lifecycle remains unknown and no correction relationship is invented.
Keep source dates, A318-A321 designations, EASA.A.064 and manufacturer; remove ATA text from the normalized subject and normalize ATA 57 title to Wings.
Use separate exact-model groups for A318/A319/A320 and A321 because paragraph 1(a) assigns different Service Bulletins to those populations.
No formal definition clause is present; keep an empty array.
Preserve the migrated bearing, maintenance without special tools, possible assembly/flap separation and loss-of-control consequence; keep correction history separate from the unsafe-condition cause.

Use eight atomic clauses: two model-specific inspections, migrated-bearing replacement, contact plus model-specific correction branches, and two ongoing prohibitions. Preserve 'before further flight' versus 'before next flight' exactly.
Retain all four explicit paragraph 2 alternatives and apply them only to paragraph 1 requirements, not to the paragraph 3 ongoing prohibitions.
No previous-action-credit clause is stated; paragraph 2 alternatives are exceptions, not credit.
Retain the two dated A320-57-1144 editions and dated A320-57A1146 alert SB with later-approved-revision allowance; do not infer missing titles.
Keep the relationship list empty because the structured field explicitly states None and no distinct correction target publication is in scope.
Retain the exact EASA AMOC authority plus the printed regulatory and Airbus technical contacts.
Classify A320 family, ATA 57, mixed one-time/ongoing frequency and conditional branches; derive action types from the resolved clauses and keep human_confirmed=false.

overall_rationale: Source-grounded third-machine reconciliation of frozen A/B submissions; the candidate remains unreviewed and must be independently confirmed by a human before it can enter the gold set.
